items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: One of them is Cousins and the other one is Trabbe K.

ctx.x: It has his name and sign there. Yeah, A. Nunes. He sent us that picture. Yeah. The first band, not WWL, but WLW. Remember? That before WWL? Yeah. The first band went in on the air. That's them. That's... That's Mallow. That's one of the Mallows. And that's Bud Loyer Canna. That's Emile Q. That's my son. And... One of them is Cousins and the other one is Trabbe K. I don't... This fella is dead too. And he's dead. And he's dead.
The banjo and the drum and the sax is dead.
